general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: A person cannot be jailed just for supporting an unpopular political idea.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Belief-alone protection and separate-crime limitation are taught and applied.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: It allows an exception when the service is punishment for a crime after due conviction.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Forced service and the due-conviction exception are explained and tested.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Section $19$ forbids excessive fines and cruel, degrading, or inhuman punishment.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Fine protection, related Section 19 protections and current statutory penalties are covered.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: A lawful conviction does not give officials permission to abuse a prisoner.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Punishment dignity, detention conditions, death ban and replacement penalties are taught.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: An earlier accusation does not always block a later case.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Same-offense conditions, included offenses and law/ordinance cases receive worked examples.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: An **ex post facto law** applies a harmful criminal-law change backward.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Meaning and applications cover earlier lawful acts and increased punishment.
